title: Goldman Sachs asset arm forms AI investing platform, memo shows
excerpt: Goldman Sachs Asset Management has launched an artificial intelligence investing platform, AlphaAI, betting that AI will become an important ‌driver of inves...
content_html:
NEW YORK, July 30 (Reuters) - Goldman Sachs Asset Management has launched an artificial intelligence investing platform, AlphaAI, betting that AI will become an important ‌driver of investment returns across its public and private market businesses.

Lou D'Ambrosio ‌will lead AlphaAI, as chairman of Artificial Intelligence for Asset Management, according to an internal memo seen ​by Reuters.

"We believe AI is both reshaping industries and acting as a force multiplier in how we invest," said Marc Nachmann, global head of Goldman's asset and wealth management arm, in the memo.

D'Ambrosio led the Value Accelerator, which he founded in 2018, chairs ‌the firm's AI Investing Leadership ⁠Council, and previously served as CEO of both private and public companies.

"We expect AI to drive greater dispersion within sectors, not just ⁠across them, and that isn't necessarily reflected in prices," D'Ambrosio told Reuters in an email.

"AlphaAI is built to find it, drawing on what we see across the breadth of ​our public ​and private markets business, and what we're ​learning inside our portfolio companies — where ‌we already have over 100 scaled AI use cases," he said.

Darius Adamczyk, who has co-led the Value Accelerator, which helps portfolio companies grow and create value by using the Goldman Sachs network, will assume global leadership of the business, the memo said.

"Over nine years we've embedded more than 100 operating executives directly into our investment process, ‌and the job now is to continue ​to add process, talent and execution rigor as we ​partner with strong management teams ​to drive growth, expand margins, and build great companies," Adamczyk said.

Exchange-traded ‌funds focused on AI are proliferating, even ​while it remains ​unclear which companies will emerge as the long-term winners from the latest technology revolution.

Funds and ETFs domiciled in the U.S. investing in the AI theme manage ​a total of $40.5 billion, ‌according to data from Morningstar.

Defiance Quantum ETF, which manages $4.88 billion and focuses ​on quantum computing, machine learning, and enabling technologies, is among the largest ​funds.

(Reporting by Saeed AzharEditing by Rod Nickel)

content_html_zh:
路透纽约 7 月 30 日 - 高盛资产管理公司推出了人工智能投资平台 AlphaAI，押注人工智能将成为其公共和私人市场业务投资回报的重要驱动力。

根据路透社看到的一份内部备忘录，卢·丹布罗西奥 (Lou D'Ambrosio) 将担任资产管理人工智能董事长，领导 AlphaAI。

高盛资产和财富管理部门全球主管马克·纳赫曼(Marc Nachmann)在备忘录中表示：“我们相信人工智能正在重塑行业，并成为我们投资方式的力量倍增器。”

丹布罗西奥 (D'Ambrosio) 领导了他于 2018 年创立的价值加速器 (Value Accelerator)，担任该公司人工智能投资领导委员会主席，此前曾担任私营和上市公司的首席执行官。

丹布罗西奥在一封电子邮件中告诉路透社：“我们预计人工智能将推动行业内更大的分散，而不仅仅是跨行业，这不一定反映在价格上。”

他说：“AlphaAI 的建立就是为了找到它，借鉴了我​​们在公共和私人市场业务中所看到的知识，以及我们在投资组合公司中学到的东西——我们已经拥有 100 多个规模化的人工智能用例。”

备忘录称，价值加速器（Value Accelerator）旨在利用高盛网络帮助投资组合公司发展并创造价值，达里厄斯·亚当奇克（Darius Adamczyk）将担任该业务的全球领导者。

Adamczyk 表示：“九年来，我们已将 100 多名运营高管直接纳入我们的投资流程中，现在的工作是继续增加流程、人才和执行严谨性，与强大的管理团队合作，推动增长、扩大利润并打造伟大的公司。”

专注于人工智能的交易所交易基金正在激增，尽管目前尚不清楚哪些公司将成为最新技术革命的长期赢家。

根据晨星公司的数据，在美国注册的投资人工智能主题的基金和 ETF 管理的资金总额为 405 亿美元。

Defiance Quantum ETF 管理着 48.8 亿美元，专注于量子计算、机器学习和支持技术，是最大的基金之一。

（赛义德·阿扎尔报道，罗德·尼克尔编辑）
